title: Owner-composed household manipulation flagship
description: Extend the existing Frankensim mathematical owners into a second flagship: a parametric home-scale KUKA/FANUC-style arm performs black-box pick-and-place of irregular household objects across kitchen, living-room, and backyard scenes. Reuse fs-ga SE(3)/Lie algebra, fs-mbd articulated dynamics and the existing KUKA catalog, fs-contact, fs-tribo, and the schema-2 scalable CMA family; do not create a parallel robot-math representation. First make one physically honest manipulation task excellent before multiplying scenes.
acceptance_criteria: Owner-composed arm and gripper model with provenance; collision/contact receipts for at least three irregular objects; deterministic objective resistant to early-termination reward hacking; worker-based separable/LM-CMA/LM-MA optimization; owner-derived Three.js poses with an explicit display-only-vs-dynamic legend; tests proving every policy coordinate affects the task and optimized replay improves a fixed baseline; mobile/desktop smoke tests with zero page, console, or network errors.

title: Promote G1 flagship to source-bound whole-body walking
description: Extend the current proven 15-DoF lower-body-and-waist flagship in place to the source-bound whole Unitree G1 only after the full catalog, inertias, joint limits, collision geometry, and controller interfaces have owner provenance. Preserve the existing SE(3), multibody, contact, friction, policy, and CMA owners; avoid a browser-side physics island.
acceptance_criteria: Whole-body catalog provenance and symmetry tests; arm and upper-body dynamics participate in rollouts; stable upright reference lasts the full horizon; meaningful gait curriculum and fixed held-out replay; optimization beats the zero/reference baseline across multiple declared seeds without reward hacking; render consumes all owner poses; performance stays interactive in a worker with published browser measurements.
